actionItems.text: Link his MR in the agenda and share his screen to show it to the team.
Create an MR to stub out a checklist for sales play launch readiness.
Reach out to Hannah, Chris Wang, and Kelly (SMB enablement) regarding SDR enablement requirements and schedule time with them.
Double-check with Darren on the runner team for 14.o plans and follow up with Brian.
Query PM counterparts about their plans for 14.o.
Sync with the new C-level regarding 14.o plans.
Plan the activities for the 14.o launch.
Open an MR to update the release post managers page to reflect the 14.o launch ownership change.
Create a slide for the Group Conversation (GC) deck focusing on outcomes and measurement for GTM motions.

chapters.title: Meeting Start & Agenda
chapters.gist: William opened the weekly product marketing meeting for April 12th with a light agenda.

chapters.title: Sales Plays Timeline Discussion
chapters.gist: William raised concerns about the sales plays timeline, noting that team members might not have committed to the proposed dates.

chapters.title: DRI for Sales Play Dates
chapters.gist: Cindy suggested that the DRI for sales play schedules and work plans should be the lead for each GTM motion, with PMM ensuring alignment.

chapters.title: DevOps Platform Sales Play Status
chapters.gist: Cormac discussed ongoing discussions about the DevOps platform sales play, suggesting finishing the play but potentially tabling the associated campaign due to lack of sales appetite.

chapters.title: Brand Messaging vs. Use Case Separation
chapters.gist: Brian shared his work on separating brand messaging from the use case, which has caused confusion, and William requested he link the MR and share his screen.

chapters.title: Sales Play Launch Definition
chapters.gist: Samia questioned what constitutes 'launching a sales play,' prompting Cindy to suggest creating an MR template with a launch readiness checklist.

chapters.title: SDR Enablement Contacts
chapters.gist: Samia asked for global SDR enablement contacts, and William identified Hannah and Chris Wang, with Cindy adding Kelly for SMB enablement.

chapters.title: 14.0 Release Launch Ownership
chapters.gist: William proposed Brian own the 14.o launch, which is a major release typically involving press announcements, and confirmed Samia and Parker's availability for other releases.

chapters.title: 14.0 Release Content Ideas
chapters.gist: Brian discussed potential content for 14.o, including a breaking changes blog and a year-end review, and the team discussed coordinating with PMs and Natasha for special activities.

chapters.title: Group Conversation Deck Format
chapters.gist: William expressed dissatisfaction with the current Group Conversation (GC) deck format, advocating for a shift from reporting activities to outcomes and results.

chapters.title: Partner vs. Competitor Strategy
chapters.gist: Alida sought input on the strategy for handling vendors who are both partners and have overlapping capabilities, specifically whether to have only a comparison page, only a partner page, or both.

chapters.title: Analyst/Third-Party Input for Scoring
chapters.gist: Alida proposed consulting analysts or hiring a third-party firm to help with competitive scoring, while William strongly criticized the current comparison graphic for its lack of credibility.

chapters.title: Scalability of Competitive Page Updates
chapters.gist: William suggested a tiered approach to competitive pages, where PMMs would update 1-3 top tools quarterly as a core competency, making the process more scalable and reasonable than updating 80+ tools.
